headline: Recommended new policy File ACL on interacting with law enforcement officers engaged in civil law enforcement.
summary: Superintendent Amy Pasquarello presented a new policy, File ACL, on how staff interact with law enforcement officers engaged in civil law enforcement. The policy follows recent guidance from Governor Maura Healey's Office. Members voted unanimously to recommend the policy to the full committee.
decisions: Recommended policy File ACL, Interacting with Law Enforcement Officers Engaged in Civil Law Enforcement (Protect Act), to the full School Committee, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: it was unanimously VOTED: To recommend to the full School Committee Policy File ACL - Interacting with Law Enforcement Officers Engaged in Civil Law Enforcement (Protect Act)

THE GLOUCESTER PUBLIC SCHOOLS 
Our mission is for all students to be successful, engaged, lifelong learners 
Program Subcommittee Meeting Minutes 
Monday, September 14, 2026 
GHS Library and via Zoom 
32 Leslie O. Johnson Road, Gloucester, MA 01930 
6:15 pm 
Members Present  Administration Present 
Laura Wiessen, Chairperson Amy Pasquarello, Superintendent 
Heather Dagle  
Andrea Liacos  
This meeting was conducted with the School Committee in person 
and the public participating in person and remotely via Zoom. 
I. CALL TO ORDER - Chairperson Wiessen called the meeting to order at 6:16 pm
Effective August 16, 2023, the public is welcome to attend in person.  Alternatively, the
public may attend through the zoom link below.  Meeting notice will reflect if the
meeting is Zoom only.  As the recent amendments to the open meeting law allows, the
School Committee may continue to hold meetings remotely.  Please note the in-person
meeting will not be suspended or terminated if technological problems interrupt the
remote connection.  If you are calling in on a phone, you can press Star 9 (*9) to request
to speak.  If you are watching on a computer or device, there is a “raise hand” button that
you can tap or press to request to speak.  Please use either of these options during oral
communications to be recognized to speak.
II. REPORT DELIBERATIONS/DISCUSSION
A. File ACL - Interacting with Law Enforcement Officers Engaged in Civil Law
Enforcement (Protect Act)
